title: Creating the account
summary: Makes the device-first account after the last step: device check (attestation), POST /v1/signup with a retry key, storage of the hidden password and the recovery token, then sign-in with the Matrix SDK. The person sees one progress state, or an error that sends them back to the step that can fix it.

termsVersion.description: The version the person accepted on signup-name.

inviteCode.description: From the link, the paste or signup-invite-code.

phase.description: attesting: the device check runs. creating: POST /v1/signup runs (and retries). signingIn: credentials are stored and the SDK signs in. failed: see error. done: go to signup-done.

error.description: The reason for failed. Each maps to one string and one way out (see notes).

start.effect: Gets or makes the pending sign-up (a signup_key of 32 random bytes, kept on this device with the PIN before the first request), runs the device check, then sends POST /v1/signup with display_name, pin, email, invite_code, terms_version, lang, attestation and signup_key.

retry.effect: From failed: runs start again with the same signup_key, so a request that reached the server returns the same account (ADR 0094).

fix.effect: From failed with inviteInvalid, termsRequired, pinWeak or emailTaken: goes back to the step that owns the field (signup-invite-code, signup-name, signup-pin, signup-fallback) and keeps the other answers.

notes: Device check (ADR 0022, ADR 0043). iOS: App Attest with a one-time challenge from POST /v1/attest/challenge; when Apple's service is down after one more try, send no attestation and let the server decide (SIGNUP_ATTEST_REQUIRED). Android: Android Key Attestation, no Google library (bipe-chat/bipe#92, MZ 25 Oct 2026): a new EC key in the Android Keystore with the challenge from POST /v1/attest/challenge as its attestation challenge (StrongBox when the phone has it, else the TEE), then key_attestation_chain from its certificate chain; the app deletes the key after the request. When the phone cannot make the key or the chain, the app sends no attestation and shows no error. A phone that cannot attest still gets an account while the switch is off; the server holds the attestation state, never the client.

Retry key (ADR 0094): the signup_key and the PIN of the first try are kept on this device (iOS Keychain ThisDeviceOnly, Android storage without backup) until the credentials are stored. 429 with reason signup_in_progress: wait a few seconds and send again, without showing an error. After a 4xx field error the server made nothing, so the next try takes the PIN from the form again; after 429 or 5xx the PIN of the first try stays.
A lost answer is finished on the next launch: account-start calls POST /v1/signup/resume with the kept key (404 drops the key).

Storage (ADR 0059): the hidden password on this device only (iOS Keychain ThisDeviceOnly, Android storage without backup); the recovery token in the synced store (iCloud Keychain, Block Store). Then Client.login with the user ID and the password (MAS compatibility login, m.login.password). Never log or show either.

Error map: network, bipe_error_network, retry. rate_limited, bipe_error_rate_limited, retry. invite_invalid, bipe_error_invite_invalid, fix. terms_required, bipe_signup_terms_required, fix on signup-name (untick the box). pin_weak, the pinProblem() string, fix. email_taken, bipe_error_email_taken, fix. attestation_invalid, bipe_error_attestation_invalid. Attestation that fails on the device, bipe_error_attestation_failed (iOS only), retry. Sign-in fails after the account exists, bipe_signup_signin_failed, retry signs in again without a new request. Anything else, bipe_error_generic, retry.

Bipe logic: BipeAPIClient.signup, BipeAPIClient.resumeSignup, BipeAppAttest.attestationUnlessServiceDown, BipeCredentialStore.pendingSignup, save and saveRecoveryToken (iOS); BipeDeviceAccount.signUp, resumePendingSignup and storeCredentials, BipeRecoveryTokenStore (Android). Move them, do not rewrite them.
The @ is not sent here; handle-pick sets it later. inviter_user_id from the answer goes to signup-done.
